items.text: Jamshid Barzegar said Donald Trump's support for Benjamin Netanyahu indicates increased coordination between Washington and Tel Aviv to confront the Islamic Republic. He added that the likelihood of new military operations against the Islamic Republic has increased. There is also disagreement in Tehran over negotiation or continued confrontation with the US.

Reza Pahlavi urged American voters to consider candidates' positions on the Iranian people and freedom. He stated that a free Iran benefits both Iranians and the world and called the Islamic Republic the root of the crisis. He emphasized that the only sustainable solution is to remove the regime.
